$comment: Per-host SPKI pins for the MASQUE/WARP edges. Loaded by aether::trust and
validated by trust::active_pins() at startup: a host with zero unexpired
pins is a hard error, never a fallback to 'trust everyone'.
WHY BOTH PINS ARE LISTED UNDER EACH HOST: the two digests below are lifted
verbatim from consts.rs::MASQUE_PINS, where today they form one global set.
The audit defect being fixed is that the set replaced certificate
validation entirely (no chain, no validity period, no hostname) - not that
it was shared between the two Cloudflare hostnames. Splitting the digests
across hosts from an armchair would risk rejecting a live peer on a guess,
so the split is left as an explicitly measured task: observe the leaf each
SNI actually presents, then narrow. require_hostname stays false for the
same reason - the peer is dialled by IP, so tightening it needs a live
